context_for_next_testing_agent: V7 Admin Overhaul fully tested. Key changes verified: (1) Super Admin role with exclusive features (room CRUD, permanent delete, clear audit logs, admin management), (2) Sidebar restructured - no separate Recycle Bin item, (3) Recycle Bin embedded in Final Guest List with Restore button, (4) Room Management is grid-only with popup assignment, (5) New filters for arrival/departure date ranges and arrival status, (6) Row coloring for arrival status, (7) Manual Entry simplified - no management fields, (8) Registration form has additional_phone and mandatory address, (9) Language toggle repositioned below heading. All 27 backend tests pass. MOCKED: Bulk Guest Messaging send functionality (UI scaffold only, no actual SMS/WhatsApp delivery).
